**Summary**  
  

Come join a company that strives for Extraordinary People and Exceptional Performance!  
Chenega Enterprise Systems & Solutions, LLC, a Chenega Professional Services company, is seeking a Scientific Data Analyst II to support the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) by overseeing data management, reporting, governance, quality assurance, and information management activities. The successful candidate will lead the development and implementation of data management strategies, reporting frameworks, data governance processes, and data quality initiatives that support program monitoring, evaluation, and organizational decision-making.  
Our company offers employees the opportunity to join a team where there is a robust employee benefits program, management engagement, quality leadership, an atmosphere of teamwork, recognition for performance, and promotion opportunities. We actively strive to channel our highly engaged employees' knowledge, critical thinking, and innovative solutions for our clients.

Work Location:  
• The work under this position will be performed primarily in a telework environment, and/or with onsite support provided at CDC facilities as required and directed by the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR).  
• Personnel must be available during standard business hours and accessible via telephone, email, and virtual collaboration platforms.  
• Occasional travel may be required to support meetings, conferences, training events, or other project-related activities, as authorized by the COR.

  
**Responsibilities**  
  

• Support the day-to-day operation of CDC data management systems and platforms, including the CDC One Data Platform (1CDP), to facilitate data collection, reporting, and program management activities.  
• Monitor data pipelines, system performance, data flows, and platform functionality to identify issues and support operational efficiency and reliability.  
• Investigate, troubleshoot, and assist in resolving system issues, user access concerns, data anomalies, and operational challenges impacting data management processes.  
• Participate in system maintenance activities, enhancements, testing efforts, upgrades, and issue-tracking processes to support platform performance and business requirements.  
• Support backend system activities and assist in maintaining compliance with established business rules, system requirements, and operational procedures.  
• Perform routine system monitoring and validation activities to help ensure data processing accuracy, system reliability, and adherence to established standards.  
• Conduct quality assurance and validation reviews to verify the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of system outputs, reports, and data products.  
• Provide technical assistance to internal and external stakeholders, including funding recipients, by supporting system onboarding activities, troubleshooting technical issues, and addressing reporting and data-related questions.  
• Collaborate with program staff, information technology teams, enterprise platform teams, and external partners to support system operations and reporting requirements.  
• Assist with the implementation and maintenance of approved data governance standards, metadata requirements, business rules, and data management procedures within 1CDP and related systems.  
• Develop and maintain user guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), training materials, and technical documentation to support consistent system usage and operational processes.  
• Support internal and external reporting activities by generating, validating, and delivering accurate and timely data products and reports.  
• Develop, maintain, and update automated reporting processes, data workflows, and associated scripts using approved analytical and reporting tools.  
• Identify opportunities for process improvements, system enhancements, and operational efficiencies and provide recommendations to improve data management and reporting activities.  
• Perform routine and ad hoc analyses, reporting activities, data validations, and system support tasks in response to project and stakeholder needs.  
• Perform other duties as assigned.

  
**Qualifications**  
  

Minimum Qualifications:  
• Master's degree in Public Health, Health Informatics, Data Management, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related field.  
• Minimum of three (3) years of experience supporting data management, reporting, data governance, program evaluation, health informatics, or related activities.  
• Demonstrated experience managing large datasets, databases, reporting systems, and data management processes.  
• Experience developing data management plans, data governance procedures, metadata standards, and quality assurance processes.  
• Experience using SQL and data management platforms to support data integration, validation, and reporting activities.  
• Experience utilizing reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, 1CDP, Tableau, or similar systems.  
• Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, information governance, and data quality principles.

Preferred Qualifications:  
• Experience supporting CDC, HHS, or other federal public health agencies.  
• Experience working with public health surveillance systems, including infectious disease and chronic disease surveillance programs.

• Experience evaluating and utilizing healthcare data sources, including electronic health records, healthcare claims, commercial or federal healthcare datasets (e.g., HealthVerity, Premier, Truveta, IQVIA, PCORnet, MarketScan, CMS, HRSA, and VA).  
• Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards and common data models, including HL7, FHIR, and OMOP.  
• Experience leading data management teams or large-scale data initiatives.  
• Experience developing enterprise reporting frameworks and data governance programs.  
• Experience managing CDC One Data Platform (1CDP) reporting and data management activities.  
• Experience supporting program monitoring and evaluation initiatives.  
• Experience implementing metadata standards and data stewardship frameworks.  
• Project management experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder environments.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:  
• Advanced knowledge of data management, data governance, metadata management, and information lifecycle practices.  
• Strong understanding of database design, relational data structures, and enterprise reporting environments.  
• Experience managing data quality programs, validation procedures, and data stewardship initiatives.  
• Proficiency with SQL, Power BI, R, Python, SAS, and related data management and reporting technologies.  
• Experience establishing reporting standards, governance processes, and documentation practices.  
• Ability to manage multiple data initiatives and priorities simultaneously.  
• Strong leadership, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.  
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  
• Ability to translate business requirements into effective data management and reporting solutions.  
• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

**Job Description**

**Ready to take your career global?**

  

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Senior Marketing Data Analyst to join our ever evolving Marketing Operations team and help shape the future of global commerce.

  

**What you’ll own**

  

* Serve as a strategic partner to marketing and enterprise data teams to deliver business-ready data solutions.
* Leverage data-driven insights to shape, optimize, and improve marketing strategies.
* Optimize and maintain marketing data infrastructure to support analytics and reporting needs.
* Ensure data integrity while enabling scalable and efficient access to marketing data.
* Design and build scalable data pipelines to support marketing initiatives and decision-making.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and business narratives.
* Drive business growth through advanced data analysis and data visualization.
* Apply expertise in data normalization, attribution methodologies, marketing metrics, and customer lifecycle analysis.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure data-driven insights guide marketing initiatives.
* Enhance marketing performance through data manipulation, exploration, reporting, and strategic recommendations.
* Guide marketing data strategy by identifying trends, opportunities, and best practices.
* Support informed decision-making by delivering accurate, meaningful, and accessible marketing analytics.

  

**What you'll bring:**

  

* Serve as primary liaison with Enterprise Data, Finance/BI, RevOps, Tech and cross-functional partners to integrate, govern, and standardize marketing data across systems (CRM, Snowflake, Salesforce, Marketo/Pardot, GA4, and other marketing technologies).

* Lead data stewardship efforts, supporting data governance, compliance, and integration standards across platforms and global teams.

* Build, analyze, and optimize audience segments across platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ZoomInfo, CDPs, Google Analytics, Google Ads) to support global campaigns and demand generation efforts.

* Conduct deep-dive data analysis, combining multiple systems and large datasets to generate actionable insights on customer behavior, lifecycle performance, and marketing ROI.

**It's a bonus if you have:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, Data Analytics, Data Science, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, or marketing analytics.
* Strong understanding of marketing metrics, customer lifecycle management, audience targeting, lead management, and marketing best practices.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python for data extraction, manipulation, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience working with data warehouses and BI/visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Snowflake, BigQuery, Excel, and Power Query.
* Strong expertise in data cleansing, data integration, exploratory analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and data visualization best practices.
* Experience with CRM, marketing automation, and segmentation platforms such as Salesforce, Marketing Cloud/Pardot, Marketo, CDPs, Google Analytics, and similar tools.
* Knowledge of forecasting techniques, marketing analytics frameworks, attribution methodologies, and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Preferred: Experience with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), advanced segmentation, data integration concepts, and data science tools (e.g., R, Python).
* Preferred: Experience supporting multi-regional marketing teams and B2B revenue generation strategies

About the role:
The Senior Financial Data Analyst supports data analysis efforts related to insurance systems development, including data conversions, data preparation, and the maintenance of reference data that supports downstream systems such as the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Oracle General Ledger, and Ceded Reinsurance platforms.

The analyst works closely with developers to clarify requirements, validate completed solutions, and obtain business approval before implementation.
The Senior Financial Data Analyst partners closely with the VP, Insurance Enterprise Data to prioritize initiatives across the organization and collaborates with the Project Manager to coordinate releases, communicate changes, and support successful deployment of enhancements into the production environment.
Base salary for the selected candidate will range from $150,000 to $175,000, commensurate with candidate experience and expectations. Additionally, Vantage offers its colleagues performance-based bonus potential, strong health & welfare benefits, retirement plan, competitive time off plans, a highly flexible work environment, and much more.
Responsibilities & Accountabilities:

Supports the VP of Insurance Enterprise Data to ensure effective and timely development of new and/or enhanced systems/technologies.
Provides deep technical and business analysis of data such that developers can effectively create solutions that assist leaders with data-driven decision making.
Creates source-to-target mappings with support from functional business representatives.
